evaluation.scope: Offline scoring only; raw MuJoCo contact flags are retained and never neural inputs

targets.assessment_window: post-prefix motion; full-run and initialization errors are mandatory separate outputs
targets.active_improvement: Report paired differences; do not assume a positive improvement

status: Numerical calibrated-regime study; all material/calibration tolerances are hypothetical

calibration_sources.home: Repeatable mechanical jig, angle-referenced once by independent joint encoders; not motor-only calibration
calibration_sources.motor_zero: Encoder zero established while the jig holds home
calibration_sources.tendon_zero: Geometry evaluated at the one-time angle reference; distal boundary encoder zero during setup
calibration_sources.pretension: Input/output load cells during setup, not observer inference inputs
calibration_sources.spring_preload: One-time reference equilibrium and measured spring settings; simulation constructs this reference from its model
calibration_sources.routing: Fixed fixture with known nominal dimensions, not a runtime neural input
